description: Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm raised, left arm in front of body.
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm extended forward, holding the shaft of an oar, with the blade at the level of the feet, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, horizontal, in a swimming pose, right arm forwards, left arm beside the body, above a rectangle representing water, with a curved line of water over the man starting at the right hand.
A man, written at 35 degree forwards, as if standing, with both arms raised in front, written inside a circle of wavy lines.
Man, written at 45 degree forward, both arms raised at either side of the body, hand palms outwards, inside an oval with a dotted line.
A man, lying down on a bed, facing upwards, knees slightly bent, right arm under the body, left arm over the body.
Man, written horizontally, facing down, right arm in front, left arm over the body, on top of a bed.
A man, mummy form, without beard, lying on a bed with short triangular bedposts, facing upwards.
Man, standing, both arms in front, holding a stick/staff.
Man, standing, wearing a long sash-kilt, with a cone-like shape on its head, right arm in front, holding a long stick/staff, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, wearing a long sash-kilt, with two feathers on his head, right arm in front, holding a stick/staff, left arm hanging beside the body.

Man, standing, with a palm branch, stripped of leaves and a round notch on front, with the curve at the top backwards (M4), on the head, right arm in forward, holding a stick/staff, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, wearing a long sash-kilt, with a feather (H6) on his head, right arm in front, holding a stick/staff, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, bent slightly forwards, with a feather/cone on his head, angled backwards, with the arms hanging at either side of the body.
Man, standing, with a backward line on the head, right arm forwards, holding a stick/staff, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm raised In front, holding a sceptre (S42), angled towards the head, left arm in front of the body, holding a stick, resting against the shoulder.

Man standing, with a feather on his head (H8), right arm forward, holding a body-length wAs scepter (sceptre with a straight shaft, a forked base, topped with the head of the Seth animal (S40)), left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing on top of the sky (N1), right arm forwards, holding a stick/staff, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm raised, holding a conical shape at the height of the shoulder, angled forward, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm raised, holding a conical shape at the height of the shoulder, angled forward, left arm in front of body.
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm raised, holding a basin or wickerwork basket at the height of the shoulder, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, seated on heel, both knees down, back straight, arm extended in front, forearm horizontal, holding a wide cup (W10).
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm raised, holding a cup or vessel, about the size of the hand, at the height of the shoulder, left arm in front of the body.
Man, seated, right knee raised, horned viper on his head, right arm raised in front, holding the viper at the neck, left arm hanging beside the body.

Man, seated on heel, right knee up, with a feather (H6) on his head, angling backwards, right arm forwards, forearm horizontal, holding a composite bow (T10), left arm in front of the body, holding a stick which angles backwards, leaning against the left shoulder.

Man, seated, right knee raised, with a circle (sun disk) on his head, arms raised at either side of the body, supporting the sign for the sky (N1) which has the points at the hands, with the sign on top of the circle.
Man, standing, arms raised at either side of the body, supporting the sign for the sky (N1).
Man, standing, a horizontal oval on his head, right arm raised in front, with the hand at the oval, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, a circle on his head, right arm raised in front, with the hand at the circle, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, arms raised at either side of the body, supporting a vessel with a small base and a broad rim (W77), with three vertical oval loaves of bread on top of it.

Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm in front, forearm horizontal, holding a shield, left arm in front of the body, holding a mace (T3) which angles backwards, leaning against the shoulder, mace head above the shoulder.
Man, seated on heel, right leg extended with foot in front of the left leg, right arm forward, forearm horizontal, holding a shield, left arm in front of the body.
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm forward, holding a mace (T3), angling backwards, left arm over the body, holding a mace (T3), angling backwards against the left shoulder.
Man (enemy), seated on heel, both knees down, both arms behind the back, bound together with rope.

Man, standing, with a child (A17: knees at 90 degree, both lower legs visible, slightly apart, right arm raised with hand to mouth, left arm hanging beside the body) on his head, right arm raised, supporting the child, left arm hanging beside the body.

Man, seated on heel, both knees down, both arms extended in front, supporting a child (A17: knees at 90 degree, both lower legs visible, slightly apart, right arm raised with hand to mouth, left arm hanging beside the body).

Man, seated on heel, right leg extended with the foot in front of the left knee, both arms extended forwards, one arm at the height of the shoulder, one at the height of the of the chest, hand palms horizontal, hand palms upwards, inside a double dotted line running from two vessels with a small base and a broad rim (W77), in front and behind the man, with the double line of dots curving over the man.
Man, standing, right arm forward, holding a tall water pot with a spout at 45 degree, with water issuing from the spout, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, both arms forward, holding a vessel at the height of the waist, with a dotted line coming from the vessel.
Man, standing, both arms forward, right forearm above left forearm, with a ripple of water (N35) written nearly horizontally above the right forearm and hand.
A man, seated, right knee raised, both arms forwards, holding a book roll with the first page unrolled.
Man (enemy), seated on heel, both knees down, with a line of liquid coming from the top of the head, towards the front, curving downwards, both arms behind the back, bound together with rope.
Man, seated on heel, both knees down, with a line of liquid coming from the face/neck, towards the front, curving downwards, both arms behind the back, bound together with rope.
Man (foreigner), seated on heel, right knee raised, with foreign headdress and bushy beard, both arms behind the back, bound with rope.
Man (enemy), with hands bound to feet at the back.
Man (enemy), without head, with hands bound to feet at the back.
Man, curled up, right and left lower legs separated, back nearly horizontal, both arms forward, forearms horizontal, grasping a line of liquid (blood) which comes from the head.

Man, seated on heel, right knee raised, back slightly bent, both arms forward, holding a reed pipe ending in a tuyère at his mouth, behind a vessel from which a flame, which angles away from the man, comes.

Man, seated on heel, left knee raised, right hand forward, holding the top of a horizontal drill of a bow-drill, with the point of the drill in a N25-like base, left arm in front of the body, holding the bow of the bow-drill.
Man, kneeling on both knees, toes down, back bent forwards, both arms downwards on top of a grindstone.
Man, seated, both knees down, back bent forwards, both arms extended forwards, hands at a brick or block which is at the level of the knees.
Man, standing, back bent forwards, both arms downwards, holding a rectangular grain measure vessel.
Man, standing, back bent forward, right arm forward, holding a bundle of grain stalks, left arm in front of the body, holding a sickle with the point at the base of the bundle of grain stalks.
Man, seated on heel, right knee raised, with a band of cloth around the middle, both arms forward, holding an axe with the axeblade in the forehead of the man.
Man, seated on heel, both knees down, both arms forward, holding an axe with the axeblade in the head of the man.
Man, curled up, right and left lower legs separated, back nearly horizontal, both arms forward, holding and axe with the axeblade in the head of the man.
Man, curled up, right and left leg separated, with a band of cloth around the middle, both arms forward, holding an axe with the axeblade close/in the forehead.
Man, written horizontally, facing down, arms raised in front.
Man, standing, back bent forward, both arms toward the front, holding a hammer with a round head, above a spike or pointy pole.
function: Logogram (to drive in the mooring post)

description: The king, seated on heel, both knees down, with a long straight beard, uraeus and coif/long wig, both arms forward, at the top of a sealed ointment jar (W2).
function: Classifier (ointment vessel in the shape of the king)

description: The king, seated on heel, both knees down, with a long straight beard, uraeus and coif/long wig, back bent forward, arm forward, hand at the height of the waist, holding a cup or vessel (W10).
Man, seated on a chair, at a potter's wheel with a vessel on top of it, both arms forward, near the top of the wheel, right leg extended, right foot at the base of the potter's wheel.

Man, standing at a potter's wheel with a lump of clay on top of it, right leg extended, right foot at the base of the potter's wheel, both arms extended in front, right hand above the lump of clay, left hand at the top of the potter's wheel.
Man, kneeling, right foot with the toes on the ground, left foot flat on the ground, back bent forwards, arms extended forward, hands at the rim of a vessel on a low hand operated potter's wheel.
Man, standing, back bent forwards, arms extended forward, hands at the rim of a vessel on a low hand operated potter's wheel.
Man, standing, bent forwards, arms hanging downwards, extended towards the front.
Man, seated, both knees up, with covered legs and arms, with short straight beard and short hair/wig, holding a crook (HqA, S38), with the opening outwards.
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm extended forward, holding a bag with one tie, oriented away from the body, left arm in front of the body.
Man, standing, arms at either side of the body, holding either side of a stick that lies nearly horizontally over his shoulders.
Man, standing, right arm forward, forearm horizontal, holding a sedge plant (M23), which curves towards the front, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, both arms forward, left arm at the height of the shoulder, right hand at the height of the waist, holding a wick of twisted flax, consisting of a singular loop at the top (V28A).
Man, standing, bent forwards, front arm hanging downwards towards the front, rear arm bent at 90 degree, forearm and hand horizontal, rear arm hand extending beyond the front arm, at hip level.
A child, seated on nothing, forelegs separated, right arm raised with hand to mouth, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, both arms forward, right hand on top of a two-pronged mast of a ship with multiple horizontal lines between the prongs (P6), left hand below the two prongs.

Man, standing, right arm forward, hand at the height of the waist, holding the sign for longs and windpipe (F36) of the same size as the man, left arm hanging beside the body.

Child, seated on nothing, forelegs spread, right arm raised in front, hand vertical, hand palm outwards, left arm hanging beside the body.
function: Classifier to sit, to be comfortable

A child, seated on nothing, forelegs separated, with a side-lock written behind the head, right arm raised with hand to mouth, left arm hanging beside the body.
Child, wearing the red crown (S3), seated on nothing, forelegs spread, right arm raised in front with hand to mouth, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, right arm extended forwards, arm horizontal, holding the sky (N1) on his hand, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, right arm forward, right hand held horizontally at the height of the waist, holding an eye with the markings of the head of a falcon (D10), left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, left arm hanging beside the body, right arm forward, forearm horizontal, holding a sceptre.
Man, seated, right knee raised, right arm raised in front, holding a loop of cord with the ties at the top, at the height of the shoulder, left arm hanging beside the body.

Man, standing, bent forwards, both arms forwards, holding a cup or vessel at the height of the knees.

Man (king) running, wearing the red crown (S3) right arm in front, hand at the height of the waist, holding a vertical spear with the point at the top, left arm raised, forearm nearly vertical, holding a stick which runs from the head to slightly beyond the hand.
Man, standing, wearing a short sash-kilt, right arm in front, holding a long stick/staff, left arm hanging beside the body, holding a piece of cloth.

Man, with hands bound to feet at the back, in front of a pole which is forked at the top, to which the man is bound.
Man, without head, with hands bound to feet at the back, in front of a pole which is forked at the top, to which the man is bound.

Man, seated on heel, both knees down, with a line of liquid coming from the face/neck, towards the front, curving downwards, both arms behind the back, bound together with rope, in front of a pole which is forked at the top, to which the man is bound.

Man, seated on heel, both knees down, with a line of liquid coming from the neck/chest, towards the front, curving downwards, both arms behind the back, bound together with rope, in front of a pole which is forked at the top, to which the man is bound.
Man, seated on heel, right knee raised, both arms behind the back, bound together with rope, in front of a pole which is forked at the top, to which the man is bound.

Man, seated on heel, both knees down, both arms behind the back, bound with rope, behind a pole which is forked at the top, to which the man is bound with a line coming from the neck.

Man, standing, arms behind the back, bound with rope.

Man, standing behind a pig, right arm forward, holding the tail of the pig, left arm hanging beside the body.

Man, standing, right arm forward, holding a stick horizontally, left arm hanging beside the body.
Man, standing, right arm outstretched before him, with the left arm hanging beside the body.

Man, standing, right arm forward, holding a crook (S38) at the same size as the man vertically, left arm hanging beside the body.
